patterns.note: Asymmetrical page layout with a fixed left-hand navigation column and a scrolling main content area.
Prominent, elegant serif typeface for all headings, contrasted with a clean, modern sans-serif for body text and UI elements.
A sophisticated palette of off-white and deep charcoal/brown, punctuated by a vibrant, multi-color abstract animation in the hero.
Content sections reveal with a subtle fade-in and slight upward translation as they enter the viewport during scroll.
The hero features a looping abstract animation of vertical bars that shift in color and height.
News and updates are presented in a grid of minimal cards, each featuring a small abstract graphic and key funding information.

technique_notes: The site employs a fixed left-hand navigation column that remains visible while the main content area scrolls independently, creating a persistent global navigation experience.

Content sections are introduced with a scroll-triggered animation, where elements subtly fade in and translate upwards as they become visible in the viewport, likely using a library like GSAP ScrollTrigger.

The hero section features a dynamic, abstract animation of vertical bars that continuously shift in color and height, serving as a visually engaging focal point, likely implemented with CSS keyframes or Lottie.

design_tokens.type_scale: Hero heading is very large and elegant (~3-4x body), subheadings are also serif but smaller, body text is a readable sans-serif.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle, almost sharp for most elements like buttons and cards.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced overall, with airy spacing in the hero and between major sections, creating a sense of calm and importance.

standout: The most distinctive aspect is the persistent, fixed left-hand navigation column, which gives the site an editorial or application-like feel rather than a typical marketing page. This, combined with the elegant serif typography and the abstract, colorful hero animation, creates a sophisticated and unique brand presence.
